= Vendored docs-team-standards files

Copies of the Vale style and the page templates from redpanda-data/docs-team-standards, which is the source of both.
They ship in this package so the docs language server can use them offline.

* `templates/`: `resources/templates/*-template.adoc`, one per topic type.
* `vale/`: `vale/.vale.ini` and `vale/styles/`. Run `vale --config vendor/dts/vale/.vale.ini <file>`.
* `manifest.json`: the source commit and a sha256 for every file.

Every file is byte-identical to its source.
The `sync-dts-vendor` workflow refreshes the copy every day and opens a pull request when it changes.
The tests fail if a file here no longer matches the manifest.

This package is public on npm, so anything added to these source paths in redpanda-data/docs-team-standards becomes public when the sync pull request merges.
